content:
TEMPTATION ||| Lean in closer, letting my breath catch his skin ||| "What if I told you I could change everything?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, creating a deliberate distance between us ||| "Not here, Julian. We need to focus on the ritual."  
CONFESSION ||| Meet his gaze, the truth spilling from my lips ||| "I feel more for you than I should."  
REVERSAL ||| Pull the blade from my hand, claiming its weight ||| "I will answer, but only on my terms."  
SILENCE ||| Hold my breath, feeling the tension in the air ||| mm
